# netbox_data_sources (Data Source)

Lists data_source objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_data_sources" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-data_source" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: enabled, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner_id, owner_id__n, source_url, source_url__empty, source_url__ic, source_url__ie, source_url__iew, source_url__iregex, source_url__isw, source_url__n, source_url__nic, source_url__nie, source_url__niew, source_url__nisw, source_url__regex, status, status__empty, status__ic, status__ie, status__iew, status__iregex, status__isw, status__n, status__nic, status__nie, status__niew, status__nisw, status__regex. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `data_sources` (Attributes List) The matching data_sources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_sources))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--data_sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_sources`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether NetBox synchronises from this source.
- `file_count` (Number) Number of files synced from the data source.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `ignore_rules` (String) Newline-separated glob patterns of files to ignore when synchronising.
- `last_synced` (String) When NetBox last synchronised the source.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `parameters` (String) Backend-specific parameters as JSON text (use jsonencode()).
- `source_url` (String) URL or path of the source.
- `status` (String) Synchronisation status reported by NetBox.
- `sync_interval` (Number) Automatic synchronisation interval in minutes. One of: 1, 60, 720, 1440, 10080, 43200.
- `type` (String) Kind of backing store. One of: local, git, amazon-s3.
- `url` (String)
